surfaces.source: uv.lock FastMCP 4.0.11: fastmcp/server/mixins/transport.py:run_http_async -> fastmcp/server/http.py:create_sse_app; MCP 2.3.0: mcp/server/sse.py:SseServerTransport. Reached by slopsearx/mcp/server.py:main when transport=sse. FastMCP settings default message_path=/messages/ (fastmcp/settings.py); configurable with FASTMCP_MESSAGE_PATH. SseServerTransport mounts an ASGI app at this prefix. Runtime inspection: create_server().http_app(transport="sse").routes.
surfaces.conditional: Mounted only when MCP_TRANSPORT=sse. The Starlette Mount itself has no method list; its configured advertised message prefix is /messages/, and the actual Starlette route.path is /messages; handler expects POST with session_id and a JSON-RPC message. Missing session_id or invalid JSON returns 400, unknown session returns 404, accepted messages return 202. No auth is installed by the current SSE CLI branch. T01 runtime capture corrects the earlier route-only inspection: the Mount has no method list, but the locked SDK handler rejects non-POST requests with 405 and enforces its request-body size limit.
surfaces.regression_gap: No SSE transport tests exist at the pinned baseline; T01/T06 must add route, message handling and unauthenticated-mode contract coverage.
surfaces.route_kind: ASGI Mount; the route itself declares no HTTP method allowlist
surfaces.mount_path_normalization: FastMCP passes the trailing-slash message_path /messages/ to Starlette Mount, whose normalized route.path is /messages.

sdk_provenance.oauth_route_evidence: FastMCP 4.0.11 and MCP 2.3.0 from uv.lock; inspected locked cached source for FastMCP OAuthProvider.get_routes, Streamable HTTP route construction and MCP create_auth_routes/create_protected_resource_routes. The application config enables DCR/revocation and sets resource_server_url={issuer}/mcp. Contract tests cover OAuth discovery/full flow, but do not assert protected-resource metadata; T01 must capture and compare every SDK route/schema at locked versions.
sdk_provenance.sse_route_evidence: FastMCP 4.0.11 from uv.lock; inspected locked cache source for fastmcp/server/mixins/transport.py, fastmcp/server/http.py:create_sse_app, fastmcp/settings.py, and MCP 2.3.0:mcp/server/sse.py:SseServerTransport. The configured message prefix defaults to /messages/ but the actual Starlette Mount.path normalizes to /messages with methods unrestricted (*); successful session posts are sent to the advertised prefix. FASTMCP_SSE_PATH and FASTMCP_MESSAGE_PATH override paths. Current slopsearx.mcp.server.main SSE branch constructs create_server() without OAuth/static bearer config. No baseline SSE route tests exist; create them in T01/T06.
sdk_provenance.runtime_route_snapshot: Inspected local locked environment without lifespan startup/provider/network calls: create_server().http_app(transport="sse").routes yielded /sse GET+implicit HEAD and Mount path /messages (*); make_http_app(create_server(oauth=settings,oauth_provider=provider),"").routes yielded OAuth metadata GET+HEAD+OPTIONS, authorize GET+HEAD+POST, token/register/revoke OPTIONS+POST, protected-resource metadata GET+HEAD+OPTIONS, and /mcp DELETE+POST. Preserve advertised message prefix /messages/ separately from normalized Mount.path /messages.
